div.div: 4 اركضت , said of a woman, (K,) or of a mare, (A 'Obeyd, S, O, L,) (tropical:) Her fœtus became large in her belly, and moved about: (S, O, L, K:) or her fœtus moved about in her belly: (A 'Obeyd;) and so ↓ ارتكضت , said of a she-camel. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
